_local_override: Copy this file to parallel-work-config.local.json (gitignored) to override per-machine. Only include fields you want to change. Env var CODEFLOW_WORKTREE_MODE also overrides worktree.mode.

_mode_notes.disabled: Single window only. Does not support concurrent windows safely — no worktree isolation, no file claim enforcement.
_mode_notes.autorun: Worktrees created by orchestrator only. Interactive sessions run without worktrees.
_mode_notes.always: Every session gets an isolated worktree. Recommended for concurrent work.
